action.objective: Commit Kg3, the only verified safe king escape from the knight check.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search found Kg3 (f2g3) best at exact 24, clearly ahead of Kf1/Kg1 (upper bound -32, real score possibly worse) and Qxd3 (bound -383, losing the queen). Single-candidate verification at depth 2 confirmed exact 24 with no mating reply and tactical refutation not_found (checking_chain_refutation unknown only for longer mates beyond the bounded probe). f2g3 is the only commit-ready move; Kg2/g1 leave the king exposed to Qe1+ lines. Commit Kg3.
